title: Settings
subtitle: Model, semantic search, private materials and general options; each section saves on its own.
footer: Secret backend: {{backend}} (keyring = OS credential store, file = local 0600 file)

model.title: Model
model.description: The LLM used by chat and plan generation. The key is write-only: only a mask is ever shown.

baseUrl.label: Base URL
baseUrl.invalid: Must start with http:// or https://

apiKey.label: API key
apiKey.hint: Write-only: leave blank to keep the current key; only a mask is shown afterwards
apiKey.invalid: Key must be at least 8 characters

maxTokens.label: Max output tokens
maxTokens.invalid: Must be an integer between 256 and 8192

model.testHint: Send a 1-token probe using the values in this form (nothing is stored)

embedding.title: Semantic search
embedding.description: Embedding config for vector search. Without it, search falls back to keyword (FTS) and the assistant is unaffected.

unconfigured.title: Semantic search is off
unconfigured.body: Search currently uses keywords (FTS) only. Once embeddings are configured and saved, vectors rebuild in the background.

baseUrl.label: Base URL
baseUrl.hint: e.g. https://api.openai.com/v1 or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint
baseUrl.invalid: Must start with http:// or https://

dim.label: Dimension
dim.hint: Leave blank to let the first probe fill it in
dim.invalid: Dimension must be an integer between 1 and 8192

apiKey.label: API key
apiKey.hint: Write-only: leave blank to keep the current key
apiKey.invalid: Key must be at least 8 characters

embedding.saved: Semantic search settings saved; vectors rebuild in the background
embedding.testHint: Request one embedding with the values in this form (nothing is stored)

index.title: Index
index.description: Rescan content/ and private materials into the database; progress refreshes every second while running.
index.failedFallback: The task ended in failure; try a full rebuild again
index.building: A task is already running; tracking its progress
index.rateLimitedHint: Rebuilds are limited to once every 5 minutes (§7.10); the buttons re-enable when the countdown ends.
index.note: A full rebuild only reindexes content/; rescan private materials (data/private) in the Private materials section below.

private.title: Private materials
private.description: Drop your own markdown into data/private, rescan, and it becomes searchable (it never enters the public content pack).

dir.label: Folder
dir.hint: An absolute path inside data/private; save an empty value to restore the default data/private

result.title: Last scan
result.empty: No scan yet; save a folder and press Rescan.

general.title: General
general.description: Language, port, code runner switch and data management.

language.label: Language
language.hint: Applies immediately and is written to settings

port.label: Port
port.hint: The start script picks a port in 8000–8010; this page is read-only

runner.label: Enable code runner
runner.hint: When off, in-page run entry points on algorithm pages are hidden; nothing else changes. Also written to localStorage.runner_enabled
runner.failed: Saving the code runner switch failed; reverted

reset.label: Reset data
reset.hint: Wipe plans and index data (requires typing DELETE)
reset.unavailable: Not available: the backend has no wipe endpoint yet, so this version does not offer the action.

partial.title: Behaviour without semantic search
partial.body: Search still returns keyword results; vectors only refine ranking, and plan generation is unaffected.

error.offline: The backend is unavailable: model test/save buttons are disabled and other settings are read-only.
